message.content: {"caption":"AppWorld validation performance across training steps for a baseline and four attributing settings.","description":"A multi-series line chart plots Avg@8 (%) vertically against Training Steps (%) horizontally, from 0 to 100. The vertical scale is marked at 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60; plotted values include points below 20. The dashed gray line with circles is Baseline; the purple line with squares is Attributing α = 0.05; the magenta line with triangles is Attributing α = 0.10; the coral line with diamonds is Attributing α = 0.20; and the orange line with diamonds is Attributing α = 0.30. All series begin near 18. The baseline rises gradually, with a small dip around 50 steps and another around 90, ending near 55. The α = 0.05 line rises to about 55 by 60 steps, then fluctuates around 51–53 before ending near 59. The α = 0.10 and α = 0.20 lines rise quickly into the 40s, fluctuate around 48–54 later, and end near 58–59. The α = 0.30 line climbs fastest early, reaching about 43 by 20 steps, then varies mostly in the mid-40s and ends near 43, below the other series.
